gates.criterion: Verified on-chain upgrade authority and documented multisig signers, threshold, and recovery procedures
Independent audit, report and remediation sign-off for exact deployed commit
Green required CI and funded local-validator invariant, rollback and adversarial tests
Named incident commander, private reporting route, on-call drill and emergency authority review
Approved reserve policy, issuer/freeze risk analysis, reconciliation and redemption failure scenarios
Applicable-jurisdiction legal classification and compliance/privacy review signed off
Independent RPC verification, operational alerts, recovery and change-management runbooks tested
Documented mainnet decision, deployment addresses, immutable release hash and sign-offs
